opposed_resolution.rule: Apply only when two elemental effects directly contest the same physical space. Technique-specific composition and scale still matter.

ice_release.interaction_rule: Use technique profile; do not reduce automatically to either component.

environment.saturated_ground: may modify lightning conduction and earth handling only when technique profile says so
environment.strong_wind: affects registered projectile/mist/fire geometry through environment modifier
environment.vacuum_or_oxygen_denial: fire techniques require registered combustion exceptions

rule: Elemental advantage modifies an opposed contest, not raw damage after an uncontested hit.
